title: Squarified tiles
text: Tile area follows value, largest first; groups sum their children.

title: Drill-down
text: Open a group with a click or Enter, go back with Backspace or the breadcrumb.

title: Keyboard tiles
text: One tab stop; arrow keys move between tiles in size order.

title: Data table fallback
text: A generated summary and a table of the whole hierarchy.
